logs.summary: On October 17, 2026, a moderate to strong earthquake struck near Khuzdar in Balochistan, Pakistan, with various agencies reporting magnitudes between 5.6 and 6.0. The shallow quake (10-25 km depth) caused widespread shaking and panic across Khuzdar and adjacent districts such as Kalat and Surab, but initial reports indicated no casualties or significant property damage.

news.headline: Pakistan Earthquake Of Magnitude 5.9 Hits Balochistan's Khuzdar, 1 Killed As Rockfall Damages Region
news.body: A 5.9-magnitude earthquake struck Pakistan's Balochistan province on October 17, killing one person and damaging several mud houses. The epicentre was located 48 kilometres northwest of Khuzdar at a depth of 25 kilometres. Abdul Rahim died after a falling rock struck him in the Naal area, officials reported.
